name: notevault
description: Full-stack note-taking application built with React, FastAPI, Firebase Authentication, and Firestore.

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.contract:generate: python backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix frontend run contract:generate
scripts.contract:check: npm run contract:generate && git diff --exit-code -- backend/openapi.json frontend/src/features/notes/generated.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run contract:check && npm run build:frontend
